title: Self-Assembling Software Ecosystem — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Selects, connects, and configures compatible modules to create a working system for a new task. A proposed ecosystem that assembles itself: given a new task, it selects compatible modules from a registry, connects them through verified interfaces, configures them, and produces a working system — checking compatibility and safety at every connection. When a better module appears, the ecosystem can re-assemble around it.
